Title: Nīlakaṇṭhadhāraṇī a.k.a.
Source: La Vallée Poussin, Louis and Robert Gauthiot. “XIX. Fragment final de la Nilakanthadharani en brahmi et en transcription sogdienne.” Journal of the Royal Asiatic Society 44/3 (1912): 629–645 (plus 1 plate). [minor stt.]
Tibetan: D 697/905
[frag. incipit] siddhayogīśvara dhuru 2 viyaṃnti mahāviyaṃnti [=vīryaṃ te mahāvīryaṃ te?] dharendreśvara cala [=cal cala?] vimalāmalamūrte āryāvalokiteśvarājījikṛṣṇajaṭe makuṭāvalamba vā pralambaṃ [?] mahāsiddhavidyādhara bala 2 mahābala mala 2 mahāmala cala 2 mahācala kṛṣṇavarṇa kṛṣṇapakṣanirghātana he padmahasta cara 2 niśācareśvara kṛṣṇasarpakṛtayajñopavīta ehy ehi mahāvarāhamukha mahātripuradahaneśvara nārāyaṇarūpabalavegadhāri he nīlakaṇṭha he mahāhālāhalaviṣanirjita lokasya rāgaviṣavināśana dveṣaviṣavināśana mohaviṣavināśana hulu 2 mālā huru hara 2 mahāpadmanābha sara 2 siri 2 suru 2 buddhya 2 bodhaya 2 bodhayāmi te nīlakaṇṭha ehy ehi vāmasthitasiṃhamukha hasa 2 muñca 2 mahāṭāṭṭahāsa ehy ehi mahāsiddhayogīśvara haṇa 2 [=bhaṇa 2] vācaṃ sādhaya 2 vidyāṃ smara 2 bhagavantaṃ lokitavilokitaṃ tathāgataṃ dadāhi me darśanaṃ kāmasya darśanaṃ prahlādaya me naṃ [manaḥ?] svāhā siddhāya svāhā mahāsiddhāya svāhā siddhayogīśvarāya svāhā nīlakaṇṭhāya svāhā varāhamukhāya svāhā mahāsiṃhamukhāya svāhā siddhavidyādharāya svāhā padmahastāya svāhā mahākṛṣṇasarpayajñopavītāya svāhā mahālakuṭadharāya [=mahālaguḍadharāya?] svāhā cakrāyudhāya svāhā śaṅkhaśabdanibodhanāya svāhā vāmaskandhaveṣasthitakṛṣṇājināya svāhā vyāghracarmanivāsanāya svāhā lokiteśvarāya svāhā sarvasiddheśvarāya svāhā namo bhagavate āryāvalokiteśvarāya bodhisattvāya mahāsattvāya mahākāruṇikāya sidhyantu mantrapadāḥ svāhā
nīlakaṇṭhanāmadhāraṇī samāptā || o ||
